note: Positions for claimed gene symbols that Ensembl cannot resolve. Applied by src/genes.py after the Ensembl lookups and assembly mapping. Each override is chosen so masking can only cover more, never less.

HCG2P7.why: HGNC:19242 'HLA complex group 2 pseudogene 7' is withdrawn and has no Ensembl ID; HGNC gives only band 6p21.3, and Koller 2026 places it in the MHC region. The span is set to the whole MHC interval used by the tier rules.
